page.layout: Running head at top: page number "172" at left, running title "De Juramenti Obligatione" at right. One column of running text, with one marginal note in the left margin beside the paragraph "Dubium primum". Below the last line, the catchword "mus" at right.

main_text.l: κρίσεως[?], dum in externa forma versa-
mur, ante dictum est :) sed respectu
utroque nomine digna omni vestra at-
nosse quo sensu juraveris; quia pejeravit,
qui quod promissum est non eo sensu
debuit: nec in solis Juramentis, sed & in
quibus bona fide agier oportet, omnino
videndum ut promissio eo prorsus sensu
quo facta est adimpleatur. Ad rem ergo,
Juramenti verba, aut clara sint necesse
tum. Ubi quatuor occurrunt casus. Pri-

page.notes: The Greek word after "Juramenti" is hard to read; I read it as κρίσεως but the letters are not certain. The catchword "mus" is the second half of "Primus" and is kept in the catchword element only. The printed ":)" is copied as printed. The left margin note reads "Casus 4" (printed as "Cafus 4").
